maria_support: FYI — customer acct acct_0XJ9 signed up via web at 2026-03-15T14:02Z. They completed email verification and the 3DS flow for a virtual card, but the free-trial credits (promo code auto-grant $200) never hit their account. Customer reports full onboarding flow completed. ticket: #SUP-12987

billing-bot: promo-engine: apply_promo skipped for acct_0XJ9, reason=pm_gate_mismatch, detail={"pm_bin_country":"US","account_region":"CA"} :thinking_face:

sam_payments: Can you paste the payment method metadata + last4? Need to see pm.type/bin and the promo_event log. Also want the internal trace id from the attempted promo run.

maria_support: PM metadata below (redacted):
```
payment_method.id: pm_7Zk
pm.last4: 4111
pm.brand: visa
pm.bin_country: US
pm.type: virtual_card
payment_intent: pi_29a (3DS: success)
promo_attempt: event_id=evt_20260315_14_03, status=skipped
```

kai_fraud: Looks like our gating rule GATE_VC_HIGH_RISK triggered because pm.type=virtual_card + bin flagged by recent fraud radar. That rule sets promo_status=skipped and flags account for manual review. I see an entry in fraud.audit: rule=GATE_VC_HIGH_RISK, score=0.82.

sam_payments: Two things to check: 1) whether the promo engine is using account.region vs billing.bin_country correctly (there was a regression where mismatched region prevented auto-grant), 2) whether email verification timing race caused the promo to be skipped (promo engine only runs after both email_verified=true AND pm_verified=true).

maria_support: Timeline from logs: email_verified at 2026-03-15T14:01:58Z, pm_3ds_verified at 2026-03-15T14:02:05Z, promo_engine_run at 2026-03-15T14:02:06Z -> promo_engine log shows skip with reason pm_gate_mismatch. So it wasn't a timing race.

sam_payments: Ok. Can we try a safe manual grant for customer and leave audit notes? Command we use for manual grants: 
```
curl -X POST https://internal.redwood/api/v1/internal/grant_credits
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $INTERNAL_TOKEN"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"account_id":"acct_0XJ9","amount":200,"currency":"USD","reason":"trial_manual_grant:pm_gate_mismatch_incorrect","metadata":{"ticket":"SUP-12987","operator":"maria_support"}}'
```

kai_fraud: If we grant, please tag in the fraud ticket and attach the pm BIN and supporting logs. We should also request a bin re-eval with risk team if this BIN is a false positive.

maria_support: Running manual grant now (doing via internal API), will post response.

billing-bot: internal.grants: request received, id=grant_20260315_0007, status=processing

billing-bot: internal.grants: success id=grant_20260315_0007, amount=200, account=acct_0XJ9, balance_before=0.00, balance_after=200.00 :white_check_mark:

maria_support: Done — credits visible in account (confirmed with customer). Updated ticket SUP-12987 with grant id and logs. Per kai_fraud, flagging for bin re-eval: https://fraud.redwood/triage/FR-4421 — assigned to kai_fraud.

sam_payments: Filed a bug (#BUG-584) to ensure promo engine uses canonical region mapping when bin_country != account_region and to treat virtual_card bin flags with lower severity for trial grants (config toggle).

tom_oncall: Noted — please include the promo_engine trace id evt_20260315_14_03 and related fraud.audit id FR-4421 in the postmortem checklist if we see >5 similar in 24h.

maria_support: Thanks all, customer satisfied. Leaving SUP-12987 open until fraud triage completes. :thumbsup:
